author: gyalchester
body:
Application

Age: 13 (turning 14 this year)

Timezone:

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes

Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes

 

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

 

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?

 

-        Yes; On my friends server as co-owner

 

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?

 

-        My biggest weakness is probably underestimating myself and self-doubt; this would affect my moderating not too much but when it comes to the choice of either banning someone or not when it is hard to tell, I might panic.

-        My biggest strength is probably leadership or teamwork; this would affect my moderating in a positive way in decision making and working with other people (community, staff, etc.)

 

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

 

-        I believe that I can improve the staff team by being online when most other would not be and listening and communicating with the community, listening to all of their ideas and bringing them up.

 

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

 

-        I think that leaders should have confidence, passion and willingness to help to truly be a great leader. I personally consider myself as a leader in some positions depending on what the job is. I think that I am naturally like this but I really like working with other people and when I do I usually tell people what to do in a nice way but make sure that work is distributed evenly, etc.

 

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

 

-        The ability to work in any team position quite well. I also think that something that distinguishes me from others is that I am willing to listen more openly than others (community) and that I think that I would work very well in difficult situations.

 

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

 

-        I think that the skills you need when interacting with the community is mostly showing that you are interested in helping and listening to them. I do believe I have these skills and that it would help me moderate on the server.

 

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 

 

-        I can commit a couple of hours on the weekends and sometime throughout the week so overall I think in a week roughly 5 - 8 hours. (When the school holidays come in 3 weeks I would be able to commit roughly 1 – 2 hours a day).

 

 

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

 

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

 

-        I would either freeze him and wait until a moderator, senior moderator or admin to come online and if he logs out ban in on that account and if possible ipban him. Alternatively I would ban or ipban if possible.

 

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on TeamSpeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

 

-        I would firstly warn him if he does not stop what he is doing punishments will be taken, and if he still does not co-operate I would either mute him and ban him from the channels or temporarily ban him from the TeamSpeak.

 

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?

 

-        I would screenshare the person from any evidence on their computer such as hacked clients in their Minecraft folder and check when last they used it (if it was on the time of the ban), check their rubbish bin if they had deleted any items recently (after I told them I was going to screenshare them), and if they deny to be screenshared it shows that they are trying to hide something which will then be sufficient evidence for the ban.

 

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

 

-        I would immediately ask the staff member to delete that screenshot and I would report this to a higher staff member.

 

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

 

-        I would express my decision to the Senior Staff member and I would give him reasons to support my claim and if he doesn’t agree with me after that I would accept his decision.

 

 

CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.

 

 

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?

 

-        It would mean that I would spend more time with Avicus and get to know everyone better and make more friends so I think that it would actually make my experience just so much better than it is now.

 

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?

 

-        I love Avicus, in my opinion it is one of the greatest servers of all time and it is so underrated. It means quite a lot to me since I have quite a bit of friends on here and I love the environment that Avicus gives you.

 

Do you speak any other languages than English?

 

-        Yes I do speak Afrikaans (South African) fluently which I can understand, speak, read and partially write.

 

Do you have anything else to add to your application?

 

-        Love you all <3
